raw:
{
  "question_intent": "Follow-up on trends in Equities and FICC revenues, inquire about Cash vs Derivatives vs Prime, and ask about the impact of halted US retail structured product issuance.",
  "main_topics": ["Equities trends", "FICC revenues", "Cash vs Derivatives vs Prime", "US retail structured product issuance"],
  "answer_completeness": "Partial",
  "response_stance": "Hedged",
  "evidence_level": "Medium",
  "contains_numeric_evidence": false,
  "contains_forward_guidance": false,
  "narrative_alignment": "Partially aligned",
  "question_quote": "My first is going to be a follow-up [on] Joe's question. I appreciate that you are looking at trends on both Equities and FICC revenues over a longer period of time, but so many investors are looking quarter to quarter. So keen to push you a bit more on the trends, both in Equities, where you are an outlier - anything you could say on Cash versus Derivatives versus Prime? Also, anything you could say on your US retail structured product issuance being halted. How much of the drop is explained by that and when that resumes?",
  "answer_quote": "On Equities, I think I have said all I am going to say to be honest. There is really nothing particular in there. There is nothing that concerned us in terms of the client wallet movement, there is nothing that concerned us in Prime. Cash equities, I think, were a bit weaker across the market in general, just because there is [lower] primary issuance, but nothing specific. Structured Products really is not a big business for us, and it really was not a big business market-wide in that quarter, so that is definitely not the answer. If we have not started already, I would expect us to start post the rescission offer going out. So I am sure we can come back to you on that specific timing.",
  "reason": "The answer addresses some but not all aspects of the question, providing a partial response to the Equities trends and FICC revenues, and partially addressing the US retail structured product issuance."
}
